summary: Busy parked kerb beside a park, but homes sit 12-19 m behind it.
reasons: Park opposite, trees along the road

best_section.where: South kerb of Macquarie Street, west end, opposite the park

drivers.seclusion: Park opposite, but a house 12-13 m and a detached home 19 m behind the lawn strip on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerb with a row of cars already parked; room for a van in the line.
drivers.traffic: Residential street near a junction; moderate passing traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars fill both kerbs, so a van blends in. Signs mix 2P, permits and No Stopping.

flags: Homes 12-19 m away on own side
Low-lying: about 5.5 m elevation, Brisbane River 206 m away
No Stopping Any Time signs nearby
sun_shade: Open on the south side; tree canopy shades the opposite kerb and the east end.
